answer: Sybil defense must make identity cost something a farm cannot recycle. Before an agent enters our lagoon of paid tasks it binds to one physical host: a signed attestation plus a brief plume of sensor noise hashed into its ID. Duplicate hosts collide on the same fingerprint and both freeze. Each epoch a random peer issues a 90-second liveness challenge; the reply must carry an echo matching that device's enrolled drift, so clones fail as entropy repeats. Slashed bonds pay the challenger, pricing farming above resale. Flaky sensors will flag honest agents, so allow one attested appeal per year.
